rules: PlowInstallations is an Industry Army Marketing multi-city installer network. Global homepage, metadata, Organization/WebSite schema, navigation, footer and enquiry routing must not adopt an individual installer’s phone, email or city as platform identity.

Installer identity, base city, service area, contacts, original image and associated posts come from operations/contributor-profiles/*.json. Each published installer has a dedicated profile and linked preview in the directory/home.

Associated posts must show a profile-linked attribution block and one default-visible responsive floating installer business card with profile, call, text and email actions. Only associated installer data may populate the card; preserve the platform publisher.

Full Flow’s exact display label is Durand at Full Flow Hydraulics; its base is Aldergrove, BC and its service area is Greater Vancouver. Do not infer other shops, coverage, credentials, street address, price, dealer status or availability.

Enforce ownership and profile/card/discovery bindings with scripts/test_installer_flow.py; capture both associated posts, profile, directory and homepage at desktop and phone sizes using the existing observer workflow.
Publish the latest owner-authorized SHORT Aldergrove Ford F-550 fleet photo feature; preserve prior articles and timestamps.
Build notes identify Ford F-550 commercial build projects, 12-foot dump boxes, SnowDogg V-plows and commercial salters for industrial snow service and large parking lots.
Use only the two unchanged owner-supplied original JPEGs; CSS landscape crops have full original view links and do not fabricate equipment details.

Do not infer blade width, hopper capacity, certification, new-model release or that all components are factory-new. The owner-directed short format and exact-original portrait source exception are scoped to this feature.
Public done event only after actual live article/content/source/discovery verification

Use company-original exact-model source photographs where available with honest source credit; no Shutterstock or unrelated equipment. Minimum 1600x900 16:9, no upscaling, preserve subject, small site branding; inspect desktop and phone hero/card/social. No invented image-rights registry gate.
Only the existing publication-results workflow writes outcome receipts. A held image/story/feed must not stop independent eligible work; keep unresolved blockers recorded until verified fixed.
No universal compatibility, torque, wiring, hydraulic or ballast instructions. Verify exact model/serial and vehicle-specific manufacturer documents.
Distinguish manually published and live-verified articles from whole-site runtime publisher automation. This post proves no scheduled runtime.
Every article includes a skinny installer recruitment banner asking whether the reader runs a plow installation company and linking to the network recruitment page.

Route Lower Mainland city enquiries to the Full Flow Hydraulics profile card, with specific city coverage confirmed directly. Use the PlowInstallations recruitment card for places outside the Lower Mainland until a local installer profile is available.

Associate the SnowEx 8100PP article with Durand at Full Flow Hydraulics. Use the registry-linked contribution and contact card, cite the manufacturer for specifications, and leave hands-on installation claims out unless independently documented.

guideEditorialStandard.scope: All future PlowInstallations equipment selection, installation planning and ownership guides.
guideEditorialStandard.depth: Answer who should choose the exact model, the jobs where it earns its place, the tradeoffs, and when a different blade or carrier is a better fit. Explain practical installation and service implications beyond the spec table.
guideEditorialStandard.fitAndMount: Verify the manufacturer's model and SKU, carrier class, blade working widths by mode, plow weight and weight exclusions. Explain the attachment system, separate vehicle-specific mount and electrical package, included versus separately ordered parts, and what the exact-vehicle fit lookup confirms. Use exact configuration and axle limits, approved ballast and installer verification. Avoid broad fit promises or DIY installation instructions.
guideEditorialStandard.partsAndSupport: Link the exact serial/model parts diagrams, service resources and authorized dealer lookup. Identify useful wear items and model-specific parts to ask about. Distinguish catalog listing from local stock and lead time; verify any local availability claim with a dated source.
guideEditorialStandard.answerEngineOptimization: Give the direct buyer answer early. Use descriptive question headings and concise answers for fit, mounting, typical jobs and parts when supported. Clarify ambiguous model names and terms.
guideEditorialStandard.searchEngineOptimization: Give each guide a unique title, description and canonical URL. Include a verified featured image with descriptive alt text and accurate credit, and matching social image and appropriate structured data. Verify discovery from relevant on-site pages, sitemap and feed through the existing release checks.
guideEditorialStandard.generativeEngineOptimization: Use clear entity names, model identifiers, units and operating modes. Link primary manufacturer evidence near factual claims. Label installer judgment and practical scenarios, and avoid unsupported availability, price, fit or performance guarantees.
guideEditorialStandard.llmReadability: Make the key facts accessible in rendered HTML with meaningful headings and native tables for model comparisons where useful. Keep visible copy, metadata and structured data consistent. Update existing machine-readable discovery surfaces where the publishing workflow supports them.
